# Aeldrune

> A persistent 3D browser MMORPG set in Aelvarin. The current implementation has five
> classes, a twenty-region campaign from level 1 to 200, 230 authored quests, open and
> ticketed dungeons, class equipment, skill progression, crafting, training, spirits,
> mounts and permanent collections.

This file indexes the official Aeldrune wiki. It describes the current game data and
does not advertise unimplemented systems or unpublished community channels.

## Wiki

- [How to Play](/wiki/how-to-play): Character creation, the early tutorial and the automation rules.
- [Classes](/wiki/classes): Guerreiro, Elementalista, Taoista, Besteiro and Lanceiro.
- [World](/wiki/world): The twenty campaign regions and their level bands.
- [Quests](/wiki/quests): Main, side, repeatable, city and profession quests.
- [Gear and Items](/wiki/gear): Class equipment, six progression ranks and the Codex.
- [Training and Collections](/wiki/systems): Training, crafting, gathering and permanent collections.
- [Spirits and Mounts](/wiki/companions): Summon, confirmation, collection and fusion.
- [Dungeons](/wiki/dungeons): Open world-linked dungeons and limited ticket instances.
- [Combat](/wiki/reference/combat): Single-target attack, auto-battle, auto skills, retaliation and potions.
- [Controls](/wiki/reference/controls): Current mouse-camera controls and system panels.
- [FAQ](/wiki/faq): Answers based on the current implementation.

## Play

- [Play Aeldrune](/play): Launch the local or configured online game client.
